items.stem: Total float of an activity is:

options.text: The time an activity can slip without delaying the project finish
options.rationale: Correct: total float is slack against the project end date.

options.text: The time an activity takes to complete
options.rationale: That is its duration, not float.

options.text: The cost of delaying the activity
options.rationale: Float is a time concept, not a cost.

items.explanation: Correct: total float is slack against the project end date.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO are valid ways to shorten a schedule? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Fast-tracking: running activities in parallel that were sequential
options.rationale: Correct: overlapping work can shorten duration, at added risk.

options.text: Crashing: adding resources to critical activities
options.rationale: Correct: crashing shortens critical work, usually at added cost.

options.text: Crashing tasks that are not on the critical path
options.rationale: Only critical-path compression shortens the project.
Deleting the baseline does not change the work.

items.explanation: Correct: overlapping work can shorten duration, at added risk.
